integrity: Explicit proof by beta tilted-moment recurrence and heat equation; independent numerical corroboration; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Stationary, symmetric two-state propulsion, harmonic confinement, independent additive Brownian noise; fixed persistence in (0,1); expansion near the unique thermal-bimodality threshold. Zero of next coefficient exists, but is not proved unique. Gaussian universal leading term is prior/general heat smoothing, not an originality claim.
title: Second-order persistence fingerprint at a thermal-noise shape transition
